parent.title: The Bell Below Brackenford
parent.status: brief-ready; gameplay not implemented by M01

external_gates.M00-SOURCE: Exact candidate verified in PR69; integrate/reverify against main before gameplay PRs.
external_gates.M00-OPERATIONS: FB-006 open; blocks operational readiness/activation, not design or isolated tests.

issues.title: Objective outcomes, reward ownership and telemetry envelope
acceptance: One fixture objective accepts combat and peaceful proof, awards principal XP/loot once through owning adapters, and preserves resolved outcome after restart.
Concurrent approaches, stale revisions, retries and abandoned checks cannot double-claim or reroll.
Emit versioned sanitized objective/check/reward events at commit, with no narrative text or secret mechanics.
issues.player_ui: Journal shows known objectives, next legal actions, costs, failure and retry explanation; event failure never causes reward retry.
issues.integration_risk: Do not create a generic reward faucet or copy combat XP into quest settlement.

issues.title: Small region graph, lawful travel and world consequences
acceptance: Town, wilderness and dungeon entrance connect with explicit costs, discovered edges and route IDs.
Travel duplicate/stale/reconnect, rollover and reserve guards compose with existing Turn owner; no real-time trek or field camp.
issues.player_ui: Known map/list routes, cost confirmation, inaccessible-route reasons, return-to-town and resume.
issues.integration_risk: A map icon or generic scope table does not establish traversal; local run consequences must not mutate live-world state.

issues.title: Authored dialogue, clues and fail-forward quest routes
acceptance: Q1–Q4 from the brief are reachable with combat and noncombat outcomes; missing NPC/clue never hard-locks the campaign.
One NPC and one scene map free text to approved intents with preview/confirmation and deterministic authored fallback.
Undiscovered dialogue choices, clue facts and alternate routes do not leak through queries, counts, logs or AI context.
issues.player_ui: Dialogue choices and safe free-text field, Journal clue recap, explicit intent confirmation, degraded-mode fallback.
issues.integration_risk: NPC memory, account knowledge and quest truth use separate owners/scopes. No case-file/theory-graph subsystem.

issues.title: Three native class slices, minimal species setup and companion
acceptance: Fighter, Rogue and Wizard each show a distinct native decision loop and world affordance; authored fixture stats are not full launch engines.
Human and goblin provisional slice records permit all three classes with bounded contextual traits; no separate culture or mechanical Background.
One recruitable companion supports each solo class without a mandatory trinity; evaluate one Familiar path cost explicitly before final slice gate.
issues.player_ui: Creation comparisons, native-resource explanations, species trait/appearance preview, companion recruitment/control and safe build resume.
issues.integration_risk: Do not rename basic attacks into completed class engines, promote example subclasses or make class/species shortcuts mandatory.

issues.title: Compact seeded dungeon, mechanism and two-route boss
acceptance: One authored five-landmark dungeon plus themed filler variation, meaningful checkpoint and persisted seed.
Fight the Bellwarden or resolve its mandate through the discovered release ritual; either yields one campaign completion proof via owning domain.
Boss has two readable mechanics with counterplay, retreat/re-entry and exact restore/reconnect; puzzle failure opens a costed salvage route.
issues.player_ui: Room map/list, known exits, puzzle choices, forecasted boss windup, recover/retreat and final outcome summary.
issues.integration_risk: Combat victory is evidence, not permission to write quest/XP/Gold directly; no world-boss or raid expansion.

issues.title: Food, banked Turns, rest and storage in the region loop
acceptance: Three small reviewed consumables and one rest/service use existing Turn/consumption rules; expose nightcap, reserve and recovery limitations.
Simulated rollover during/resuming encounters and Ascension cannot duplicate daily charges, reset undo eligibility or bypass capacity.
issues.player_ui: Food/booze planner, costs/yields, banked Turn state, rest confirmation and personal storage entry from town.
issues.integration_risk: Fixture integration does not activate production rollover policy or introduce a new settlement path.

issues.title: Vendor, routine crafting and one repeatable sink/faucet
acceptance: One town vendor, one routine recipe and explicit reward/service budgets support meaningful equip/store choices.
Repeatable salvage contract yields budgeted Gold; repair/provisioning consumes Gold/materials. Fixed proposal values live in versioned data, never class/client code.
Retry/concurrency, overcapacity, locked/bound items and stale prices conserve currency/custody and cannot farm quest principal rewards.
issues.player_ui: Buy/sell only permitted items, price preview, storage/carry reasons, recipe inputs/outputs and repair receipt.
issues.integration_risk: Vendor coordinates existing owners; no player market, escrow or commissioning scope.

issues.title: Campaign conclusion, first Ascension knowledge and second route
acceptance: Optional Aftercore → current preview → explicit confirm → new run retains Sluice Survey knowledge but resets local quests/NPC outcomes and class build.
Life two uses the known culvert to reach the chamber by a different route; knowledge reveals possibility, not an automatically opened door.
Repeated/stale/interrupted confirmation and rollover cannot duplicate discoveries, rewards or daily entitlement; old history remains readable.
issues.player_ui: Real ending and stay-in-Aftercore choice; preserve/reset/archive review; knowledge entry and second-run route hint.
issues.integration_risk: Reuse discovery persistence; no invented numeric Mastery grant, class-engine inheritance, forced Ascension or lore explanation.

issues.title: Typed authoring, broken-package rejection and content review
acceptance: Designer edits one monster, item, quest, encounter and loot table through Studio without editing source, validates, previews, compares and exports a candidate.
Intentionally broken references, unreachable victory, reward duplication, missing failure route, hidden-data exposure and invalid budget fail before seal.
Review records content IDs/revisions, principal budgets, secrets, lifetimes and dependencies; no live adoption in this work.
issues.player_ui: Designer UI with diagnostics linked to fields/nodes and preview of player-visible text.
issues.integration_risk: Current Studio is a foundation; mock JSON edits alone do not satisfy the no-code acceptance.

issues.title: Onboarding, second-run playtest and measured slice acceptance
acceptance: Execute all A-01–A-12 scenarios in the brief with exact source/build/content/configuration evidence.
Measure two runs per tester; record route/class changes, comprehension, fun/friction and severity defects separately from automated mechanics checks.
Refresh the eight-axis status matrix, M00 identity gap and release checklist; no production activation implied.
issues.player_ui: Keyboard/phone/reduced-motion/zoom-safe full loop with no external instructions; meaningful error and offline/reconnect recovery.
issues.integration_risk: Source CI is not usability, accessibility-device or live readiness evidence.

milestones.title: A choice changes the world
milestones.gate: Playable two-approach objective, native class difference and disconnect-safe state.

milestones.title: A complete first life
milestones.gate: Local crisis concluded, economy/daily loop and recovery are understandable.

milestones.title: A better second life
milestones.gate: Knowledge changes route, designer authors content, measured acceptance passes; operations remain separate.
